analyst.summary: Arvind is a large, vertically integrated textile and denim manufacturer benefiting from the global shift of apparel sourcing away from China, with an improving balance sheet and a small but promising Advanced Materials business. However, the stock has re-rated sharply to a rich ~32x earnings on what looks like a cyclical profit recovery rather than a structural growth step-up, and the textile business remains exposed to cotton-price and trade-tariff swings. We rate this a Hold: real strategic tailwinds, but valuation has run ahead of the underlying earnings quality.
